label: Registered foreign nationals: deadline to report a change of stay address
appliesTo: Foreign nationals holding alien registration who have moved to a new address in Korea
why: One day longer than the Korean nationals' deadline, from a different statute, with a different enforcement consequence — which is exactly why it needs its own field rather than an approximation of the resident registration rule. It is also the filing that carries a foreign tenant's opposing power, so the deposit and the immigration obligation ride on the same act.

history.note: Filed at the si/gun/gu or eup/myeon/dong community centre for the new address, or at the competent immigration office; electronic filing via Hi Korea is available in some cases. An alien registration card and something evidencing the actual address, such as the lease, are generally needed. A Korean spouse filing a household move-in report does not complete this — the registered foreign national's own filing is a separate act.
